items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I played all the time there with Frank Williams.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. It's surprising that nobody ever gets on him for -- I mean, maybe he should do one of these things, because he must be nearly --
(Inaudible) we play a song every night, Hidey-Ho and -- even Frank Williams got that when was on it. And he did a lot of other songs. Wait a minute. He did Hucka Buck and a lot of other things.
But this band he had was really a very good one at that time, wasn't it?
